verdict.rationale: Data export applies to a SaaS creative platform like Pika, but the evidence pack never documents a bulk export of user data (generations, characters, projects) or the formats it would use. Cancelling a subscription and an OpenAPI spec for generation endpoints are adjacent features, not a data-export or account-exit capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
